name: Agave

facts.what: The heart and flower stalk, cooked

caution: Raw agave is caustic and full of irritating crystals: it is edible ONLY after long cooking. The sap can burn skin. This is a traditional pit-roast food, not something to eat raw. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: A giant rosette of thick spine-tipped leaves that sends up a towering flower mast once in its life. Also called the century plant.

sections.title: Uses
sections.body: Pit-roasting for a day or more turns the fibrous heart sweet and molasses-dark; the roasted flower stalk is food too. The plant is the source of agave syrup and, elsewhere, tequila and mezcal.
